newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Osiguranje insurer's H1 profit up 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Osiguranje insurer's H1 profit up 40 pct.

text.p: Croatia's biggest insurer Croatia Osiguranje made a preliminary profit of 23.5 million kuna for the first six months of 1996, up 40 percent in the year-ago period, state news agency HINA reported.
In the first half the company invested 10 million kuna into a national programme to improve road traffic safety.

Its premium income was 984.5 million kuna with damage payouts at 699 million kuna, or 12.7 percent higher than a year ago, HINA said. It gave no comparative figure for premium income for the first six months last year.

Croatia Osiguranje, which covers some 77 percent of the country's insurance market, had a net profit of 32 million kuna in 1995. Of its total portfolio, over 60 percent is accounted for by motor liability and property insurance.
The company's ordinary shares last traded at 14.80 kuna each in May on a semi-regulated segment of the Zagreb Stock Exchange -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
